description: This file defines the TaxSettingsClient class, a PHP client for interacting with AWS Tax Settings service, including method signatures for various tax-related operations.

classes.name: TaxSettingsClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Tax Settings service, extending the generic AWS client.

methods.name: batchDeleteTaxRegistration
methods.description: Deletes multiple tax registrations in a batch.

methods.name: batchPutTaxRegistration
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple tax registrations.

methods.name: batchPutTaxRegistrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates multiple tax registrations.

methods.name: deleteSupplementalTaxRegistrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a supplemental tax registration.

methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a supplemental tax registration.

methods.name: putTaxExemption

methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a tax exemption.
